confirmed_findings.finding: Full-grid path referenced config.origin_x instead of config.origin_x_m.
confirmed_findings.action: Corrected and covered with a fully observed grid test.

confirmed_findings.finding: The previous implementation treated any UNKNOWN after observed free cells as invalid coverage, causing an unconditional safety veto.
confirmed_findings.action: frontal_coverage_valid is true once a nonzero observed-free segment exists; free_distance_m remains bounded at the first UNKNOWN or OCCUPIED cell.

refined_findings.finding: The proposed audit patch allowed an immediate UNKNOWN boundary to become valid based only on cell arithmetic.
refined_findings.action: If no OBSERVED_FREE cell exists before the first UNKNOWN/OCCUPIED boundary, return 0.0 and false.
Distance is measured from base_link x=0 to the start of the first blocking/unknown cell; no start-radius subtraction is applied.

refined_findings.finding: A centreline-only check could miss occupied returns at the corridor edge.
refined_findings.action: Any OCCUPIED cell across the configured 0.40 m corridor width stops the distance; UNKNOWN is evaluated on the centreline.
